scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run test && npm run lint
scripts.prerelease: npm run build:check && npm run security:check
scripts.release:alpha: npm version prerelease --preid=alpha && npm publish --tag alpha --access public
scripts.release:beta: npm version prerelease --preid=beta && npm publish --tag beta --access public
scripts.release:major: npm version major && npm publish --access public
scripts.release:minor: npm version minor && npm publish --access public
scripts.release:patch: npm version patch && npm publish --access public
